# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Dear Thorne  <sub>[v1 c30 P34](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is an intelligent and compassionate young woman with light curly hair and captivating eyes. She dresses gorgeously, wearing outfits with puffy sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is gentle, refined, compassionate, and highly intelligent. She possesses a talent for winning her students' love and drawing out their finest intellectual and moral qualities. Tactful, attentive, and open-minded, she encourages her pupils to reflect, investigate, and think for themselves, though her departure from traditional teaching methods occasionally appalls conservative local adults.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Agnes Thorne was hired as the first female teacher for the school in Brierley. Upon her arrival, she introduced dynamic educational methods including biweekly recitation programs, field days in the forest, daily physical culture exercises, and composition training, earning the devotion of students like Nell Harcourt and Isolde. During her first autumn, she organized a Christmas Night concert with the students to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. Later, she established an after-school preparation class for pupils aiming to take the Regent's entrance examination. Though offered a teaching position in her home district, Miss Thorne chose to remain at Brierley for a second year out of deep interest in her students. She guided her Regent's class through rigorous preparation and administered practice exams before seeing her tenure at Brierley end when the term concluded at the end of June. During exam week, she accompanied her candidates to the Academy to ensure they were settled. Later, she visited the Harcourt home as a guest on occasions such as dinner parties.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v2 c16 P22](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0022), [v2 c17 P21](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0021)_
